headline: Our Work Matters…
sub: At O'Donnell, Weiss & Mattei, P.C., we strive to provide clients with great legal representation while serving as good citizens of the communities in which we practice. We deliver highly skilled, effective, collaborative and individualized service to our clients at reasonable.

offerings.title: Your Committed, Regional Full-Service Law Firm
offerings.body: You may face a challenging road ahead, and our attorneys and staff make sure that you get the professionalism you expect from your attorney while feeling assured that your input, decisions and comfort level matter.

offerings.title: Our Clients Say It Best
offerings.body: “Jim Kovaleski is excellent! I am the beneficiary and executor of an estate. This is all very complicated for me. Jim has gone out of his way to make this easy. He answered my questions and explained things in a way I could understand. He is very professional, efficient, gets right back to you, and is super friendly as well! ”, Tony L.

offerings.title: Defined By Dedication
offerings.body: “The team at OWM was phenomenal. From start to finish, they kept me informed as they fought for me. I highly recommend them!”, Steve C.

experience.title: Reach them
experience.body: Phone and the official site are the path. Nothing here invents a retainer.

experience.title: Sit down
experience.body: A consultation looks like two people at a table, not a skyline mural.

experience.title: Leave with a next step
experience.body: What they handle is their language. We keep their nouns when harvest has them.

catalog.title: Official site
catalog.body: Menus, hours, and booking stay on their site. This preview never guesses those.
